files.description: High-pitched, raspy, and highly energetic cartoon duck voice. Features a prominent, wet lateral lisp on sibilants while maintaining good intelligibility.

notes: The audio features a single, consistent speaker with high cartoon energy. The requested duck-like lisp is clearly present and well-executed on sibilants. Intelligibility is surprisingly high for this type of voice, though there are some harsh audio artifacts and clipping towards the end.
